show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/9a8bpM
show.description: To fulfill a 1,000-day vow of humility for his father’s honor, the secret heir of the Rajmahal empire endures horrific abuse as a lowly hotel waiter. When his identity is revealed, he uses his massive wealth to buy the hotel and systematically dismantle the lives of the socialites who tormented him. Now the master of those who enslaved him, he enforces a poetic justice where his former bullies must work the very service jobs they once mocked.
